svg.title: Spectral values can be stable while eigenvectors rotate
svg.desc: A two-panel plot for a symmetric two-by-two matrix. Eigenvalue displacement remains below the perturbation norm, while the leading eigenvector rotates sharply when the spectral gap is comparable to noise.
